_readme: CLEAR-BUG REGISTRY. A bug the owner reported, or one confirmed from stored evidence, goes here the moment it is confirmed - and the pre-push gate (scripts/admin/check-open-bugs.js) BLOCKS every push while any entry is open. That is the point: a reported bug is fixed immediately, not backlogged. Only CLEAR bugs belong here (reproduced, or owner-reported with evidence); design questions and improvements go to the task list instead. Close an entry by setting status to 'fixed' with the commit hash IN THE SAME COMMIT as the fix. Emergency escape: PUSH_WITH_OPEN_BUGS=1 git push (documented, visible, deliberate).

bugs.title: getLanguageNameEnglish('de-ch') returns bare 'Swiss German', which a model reads as Schwyzerdütsch dialect instead of Swiss Standard German
bugs.source: arc-create call (arcflow A/B) titled an arc «Nebel uf em Zürisee» - Swiss German DIALECT, not the Swiss Standard German (Hochdeutsch, ss never ß) that de-ch books must be written in. Root cause confirmed in server/lib/languages.js:344's getLanguageNameEnglish, whose de-ch entry (line 48, pre-fix) was nameEnglish: 'Swiss German'. A prior fix note already existed at server/lib/promptBuilders.js:4077-4082 (buildOutlineReviewPrompt) citing this exact trap causing a full-book dialect rewrite ('S'Fescht', 'blybt stoh') and working around it there by always pairing LANGUAGE with the full LANGUAGE_INSTRUCTION + LANGUAGE_NOTE - but getLanguageNameEnglish itself, and every OTHER call site that emits bare LANGUAGE without instruction/note (buildOutlineReviewPrompt's own review-only injection at line 3948, plus two dead fallback string builders), stayed unfixed at the root.
bugs.note: server/lib/languages.js: de-ch nameEnglish -> 'Swiss Standard German (ss, never ß - never dialect)' (also fixed the identical bare label in the unused getAvailableLanguages() UI list at the same file, same trap). This is the single source of truth consumed by all ~13 call sites across promptBuilders.js and storyJobPipeline.js, so every consumer is fixed by the one change - none did a string equality check against 'Swiss German' (grepped, none found), so no consumer needed adjusting. Consolidated the duplicate hand-typed map at promptBuilders.js:4903 (buildTextProofreadPrompt) into a call to getLanguageNameEnglish instead of a second, narrower hard-coded 'de-ch' -> string mapping, per the sibling-paths rule (one source of truth for a value that exists in more than one place). Grepped prompts/*.txt for bare 'Swiss German' emissions: only the story-scorecard-judge*.txt family says 'Swiss German uses ss' - left untouched, that describes the orthography RULE for judging existing text, not an instruction to WRITE in dialect, matching the existing LANGUAGE_NOTE convention. Did not touch prompts/feedback-consolidator.txt or tests/unit/inpaint-routing.test.ts (out of scope, pre-existing unrelated working-tree changes).

bugs.title: Shared vantage plates are built from Visual Bible prose only - the Art Director's per-page emptyScenePrompt is discarded, and three selection bugs pick the wrong ground, vantage and shot
bugs.source: audit of 32 pages across 2 stories (incl. staging job_1787959478282_bz19gm36h): 25/30 plates were PROMPT-WRONG. p5 is the worked example - objects[] is [LOC003 reef passage, VEH001, ART003], the AD's emptyScenePrompt says the ship's deck planks fill the centre with the boom across frame, page shot is 'medium'; the shipped plate prompt contained none of that and carried SHOT: wide.
bugs.note: Four mechanisms, all in the vantage-canvas path (storyJobPipeline.js Phase 5a-pre-vantage), which the per-page path at the same phase never had. (1) The plate prompt was assembled from the vantage/LOC prose and DROPPED pageData.emptyScenePrompt - fixed by the hybrid plate: the AD prose is appended as a FRAMING block that outranks the setting lines, taken from the first page a shared plate serves, and the SHOT line now comes from the page's own shot. (2) getPrimaryVantageForPage took the FIRST LOC in objects[] as the camera's ground - fixed with an ordered selection: a LOC whose vantage's pages[] names this page, then the LOC the AD's emptyScenePrompt names, then an explicit dotted reference, then first-listed. (3) The vantages[0] fallback ignored each vantage's own pages[] - now matched before falling back. (4) Locations without vantages got a synthetic plate hard-coded to shot 'wide', overriding the page's framing - now inherits the page's shot. Plus the VEHICLES block demanded the whole vessel rendered even when the camera stands on it (duplicate ships, ships inside caves, wheels on land) - it now asks for the visible part only with an explicit camera-aboard clause, and the plate call carries one reference family (landmark photo XOR VB element render) named by a REFERENCE line. Template contradiction resolved: scene-expansion(-all).txt forbade dotted vantage ids for invented LOCs while story-bible-from-beats.txt asks the bible to create vantages for them. Verified by rendering p5's merged plate prompt from stored data: FRAMING carries the deck-filling prose, SHOT is medium, REFERENCE line present. Empty-scene QC is still not wired on the vantage path (open, see docs/decisions.md).

bugs.title: The 'drop locations when an empty-scene plate exists' filter has never fired on any non-trial story - it reads sceneBackgrounds before Phase 5a-pre fills it
bugs.source: reproduced on staging job_1787959478282_bz19gm36h: 14/14 pages with a grid shipped their locations AND the ship as grid cards despite every one of those pages having a plate. Census replayed getElementReferenceImagesForPage against the stored visualBible and matched the stored grid images cell-for-cell (stable ~639px cell pitch: 1920=3 cells, 2560=4, 3191=5, 3831=6) - every page's stored grid equals the UNFILTERED selection.
bugs.note: storyJobPipeline.js had `if (sceneBackgrounds[pageNum]) elementReferences = filter(type !== 'location')` inside the pageData map that PRODUCES pageDataArray. sceneBackgrounds is populated by Phase 5a-pre-vantage and Phase 5a-pre, which both CONSUME that array - so the map is {} at that point on every non-trial story and the branch is unreachable. Fix separates selection from construction: the map now stores vbElementRefs/vbSecondaryLandmarks only, and a new Phase 5a-pre-grid pass (placed after the plates exist, before every pageData.visualBibleGrid reader) applies the filter and builds the buffer. Filter now matches buildPageCompositeRefs: a plate drops BOTH location and vehicle cells; plateless pages keep everything. Same commit caps selection at 4 (was 6) at both page-grid call sites. Verified statically on the real story: 3-6 cells with a location on every page -> 1-4 cells, zero locations, no vehicle on any plated page. Related: buildPageCompositeRefs calls itself the 'single source of truth' for these filters but production page generation never calls it (only iteratePageCore + Test Lab do) - the pipeline keeps an inline copy. Also NOT fixed here: that inline copy passes secondaryLandmarks into buildVisualBibleGrid, contradicting the 2026-08-18 'a landmark photo NEVER enters the grid' decision.

bugs.title: VB reference grid arrives at Grok as a tiny thumbnail row (50x83px cells) instead of owning slot 3 at full size
bugs.source: owner (staging job_1787959478282_bz19gm36h p5) + measured from the stored grokRefImages: slot 3 is 683x683 and the two VB cells in it measure 50x83px each (0.9% of the slot area), while 2 of the grid's 4 elements were dropped entirely
bugs.note: Two defects in packReferences (server/lib/grok.js). (1) The own-slot gate `rawVbElements.length === visualBibleGrid.rawElements.length` abandoned the own slot whenever the grid still held a location, so the whole VB set fell back to composeCharWithVbRow's bundled thumbnail row and slot 3 went unused - inverting the owner's 2026-08-15 slot table on every such page. (2) Even when the own slot did fire it shipped buildVisualBibleGrid's 512px-wide SINGLE COLUMN through resize({height:1024}), so an N-element grid became a ~1024/N px sliver that the aspect-pad loop then pillarboxed inside a 1024-wide slot (4 elements -> 20% of the slot, 80% white bars). New composeVbSlot() re-flows the cells into the rows x columns closest to square for the target aspect and fills the slot edge to edge. Verified statically on the real stored p5 grid: per-element 50x83 -> 512x512, slot coverage 1.8% -> 100%.

bugs.title: Entity-consistency cell->page map is always empty (reads cell.metadata.pageNumber; createLabeledGrid flattens it), so every letter-only finding is dropped unscored

Only findings where the model volunteered an absolute pagesToFix survived (that is how Sarah's p2 MINOR got through on this story). Also why stored descriptions lack the '(page N)' annotation. Fix reads the flat field with the nested one as fallback; verified with a probe -> {A:3,B:16}.

bugs.title: Staging analyzer cannot load GroundingDINO since the ArcFace/TensorFlow image rebuild — every detection 503s
bugs.source: staging runtime log: 6x "[GDINO] Loading GroundingDINO..." each followed by "GroundingDINO unavailable:" with EMPTY error (OOM-kill signature); Lab exps #799/#800 blocked/failed on /detect-figures-text HTTP 503 ~40min after deploy of f1448757b
bugs.note: Likely memory: TensorFlow(+deepface) now resident in the analyzer alongside DINO ~1.9GB + MobileSAM. The ArcFace commits (b123a2088 opt-in warmup, 36129ad73 idle reaper) hint at known pressure. Owner: the other agent (ArcFace author) is running a smoke test and owns this. Blocks verification of the identity fixes (task #29 exp on p1 waiting). UPDATE bbd41215: new build deployed, SAME crash loop (exp #801 failed identically, 503s). The empty error comes from get_groundingdino() (photo_analyzer.py:1975) — from_pretrained throws an exception whose str() is empty; the handler at :2089 prints only {load_err}. IMMEDIATE DIAGNOSTIC: log repr(load_err) + traceback there. Suspects: (a) transformers import path now touching the TF-2.13/protobuf-3.20.3 corridor (transformers auto-detects installed TF), (b) OOM during weight load with TF resident, (c) missing pre-downloaded weights in the rebuilt image (Dockerfile pre-download step vs new layer). ROOT CAUSE FOUND: Dockerfile layer order — requirements.txt (TF 2.13) downgrades typing_extensions below torch/transformers floor; the DINO pre-fetch layer ran BEFORE the typing_extensions>=4.12 repair layer, failed, was swallowed by || WARN, and the image shipped WITHOUT DINO weights; every runtime load re-downloaded ~900MB and died with an empty-str exception. FIX: typing_extensions upgrade moved BEFORE the pre-fetch layer; loader 503 path now logs repr+traceback+cache-presence so an empty str can never blind us again. CORRECTED ROOT CAUSE (diagnostics from 538d2f540): transformers>=4.44 re-resolved to 5.x in the ArcFace rebuild; transformers 5 requires torch>=2.5 and DISABLES our torch 2.1.2 (held there by the numpy==1.24.3 co-pin TF 2.13 needs) — every model class raised PyTorch-not-found. Fixed by pinning transformers<5 (a057d8017). The layer-order fix (typing_extensions before pre-fetch) stays as hardening.
bugs.fix: ArcFace gate is now OFF by default (ARCFACE_GATE_ENABLED, server/lib/faceIdentity.js). Confirmed the cause rather than assumed it: POST /api/health/release-memory on staging reported 2336MB RSS and unload=true listed 'arcface-weights' as resident, dropping it to 1862MB. TensorFlow's ~350MB on top of GroundingDINO's ~1.9GB exceeded the container, so DINO died on load with an empty error and crash-looped. Disabled, no TF is imported at all and the analyzer returns to its pre-change footprint. The idle reaper could not have saved it: it requires the whole SERVICE to be idle, which never happens during a Lab run or a story. Re-enabling needs ArcFace out of the shared analyzer process.

bugs.title: Text refine + blind audit completed and were discarded at the bounded join — $0.236 of grok audit and deepseek rewriting thrown away, original text shipped
bugs.source: staging job_1787514666616_yw9qsv1vf (16pp, languageLevel standard): generationLog text_refine_start 20:38:36 -> text_refine_join_timeout 20:57:29, textRefineReport null, yet api_usage records text_audit 1 call grok-4.6 18,396 out $0.1169 and text_refine 1 call deepseek-v4-pro 29,931 out $0.1188. Same evening prod job_1787514321173_gvs2ojo4o0n (1st-grade) finished audit + 2 rounds in 584s and joined fine.
bugs.note: refineStoryText returned all-or-nothing, so a finished audit and a finished round 1 were worth nothing when the join deadline landed during round 2. Two causes compounded: the 300s budget was measured 2026-08-17, before 77d0fae0a put the blind audit in front of the rounds and roughly doubled the stage; and standard/advanced reading levels produce far larger payloads (this audit emitted 2.3x the 1st-grade run tokens). Fix: onProgress publishes the audit and each completed round, the join salvages the last snapshot, and the cap is 600s for long-text levels + 10s/page past ten. Precedent the cap-raise alone did not fix: job_1786998860057_o6deqtv5s lost $0.16 the same way on 2026-08-17. Regression test tests/manual/test-text-refine-salvage.js.

bugs.title: Every animal in a TRIAL story loses its species word before the image model sees it — the trial Visual Bible has no animals pool, so animals are filed as artifacts and the sanitizer replaces the name with the type

The stored page prompts read "Ein kleiner, flauschiger Tier mit weichen Schlappohren" — the word Hund is gone from all six prompts, and the German agreement break (flauschiger Tier) shows it is a blind string replacement. bugs.note: prompts/story-trial.txt VB schema offers only secondaryCharacters / artifacts / locations / backgrounds — no animals array. story-bible-from-beats.txt:138 and story-unified.txt:671 both have one, so this is trial-only. sanitizeVbIdsInPrompt (promptBuilders.js:3332) protects NAME_POOLS = mainCharacters/secondaryCharacters/animals and rewrites REF_POOLS = artifacts/vehicles/clothing to their type, which is correct for a prop (stops the name being lettered onto it, 2026-08-24 fix) and wrong for a living thing. Second defect visible in the same evidence: the substitution also fires INSIDE the entry own description, so the description that teaches the model what the thing looks like is the very text being degraded, and the bullet label becomes the first two words of the description ("**Ein kleiner** (object)", "**Eine runde** (object)").

bugs.title: Staging deploys failed for 34 minutes — charRepairTarget.js required ./logger, which does not exist, so server.js could not boot
bugs.source: Railway staging deployment 0b5acc98-90c2-426a-b982-ba41d1a69191 (commit 1140e8176) status FAILED. Deploy log: "Error: Cannot find module ./logger" at /app/server/lib/charRepairTarget.js:22, require stack charRepairTarget -> repairPipeline -> storyJobPipeline -> server.js. Introduced by 3565fced9 (20:38 CH); every push after it failed to deploy, and the /api/health commit SHA kept reporting the last GOOD build (0fb99344), so the breakage was invisible from the outside.
bugs.note: charRepairTarget.js sits in server/lib/ and the logger lives at server/utils/logger.js, exported as { log }. Every sibling uses const { log } = require("../utils/logger"); this file had const log = require("./logger"). Two lessons: (1) /api/health reports RAILWAY_GIT_COMMIT_SHA, which is the last SUCCESSFUL build — it cannot detect a failed deploy, so gating a validation run on it is unsound; check a boot-time side effect (a migration column) or the Railway deployment status instead. (2) check-no-undef in the pre-push hook does not resolve require() paths, so a bad module path passes every gate and only fails at container start.

bugs.summary: gemini-2.5-flash spends maxOutputTokens on THINKING before the answer. landmarkPhotos.js analyzeImageQuality (cap 300) measured finishReason=MAX_TOKENS, thoughts=284, answer=12 — the JSON died at {"photoQuality": 8, the /{[sS]*}/ match failed, and EVERY image returned null. The caller reads null as unusable and logs "No good images found from any source", so landmarks were indexed with no picture and no error; with forceReanalyze it can overwrite a stored photo with nothing. Likely origin of the 210 photoless Swiss rows. Sibling call analyzeLandmarkPhoto (cap 400) does not fail — it stores a 60-character truncated description that feeds the illustration prompt.
bugs.note: thinkingConfig { thinkingBudget: 0 } + cap 600 on both; verified after fix finishReason=STOP, thoughts=0, answer 75/105 tok, JSON parses. Same defect patched in 4 historical-image admin scripts. server/routes/avatars.js left alone: 4096 has headroom, works, only wastes thinking tokens. Parse failure raised from log.debug to log.warn carrying finishReason, because at debug a config fault was indistinguishable from ordinary photo rejection.

bugs.summary: The batched Art Director call truncated after page 11 and pages 12-16 silently fell back to per-page expansion (no batch retry, fallback booked under the same usageLabel). job_1788123310558: beats_scene_expansion shows 6 calls / 42,260 output tokens under one label; generationLog beats_scene_expansion_incomplete says 11/16 briefs. Root cause CONFIRMED as an undersized config cap: the default sceneDescription model gemini-3.1-pro carried maxOutputTokens 16384 in TEXT_MODELS while OpenRouter's top_provider.max_completion_tokens for google/gemini-3.1-pro-preview is 65536 (checked 2026-08-31) — the call site already passes maxTokens=null (full cap), so the config cap WAS the effective truncation point.
bugs.note: models.js: gemini-3.1-pro maxOutputTokens 16384 -> 65536 (real OpenRouter limit; the old judge-context caveat kept — the cap was never the judge fix). beatsPipeline.js: the all-pages call now retries the batch ONCE when it parses fewer briefs than beats (first attempt's pages win the merge, retry only fills gaps), with a loud log.error + genLog beats_scene_expansion_truncated naming the missing pages; the existing beats_scene_expansion_incomplete warn still names every page that ultimately fell back. Per-page fallback calls now book under usageLabel beats_scene_expansion_fallback so a truncated batch is visible in the usage summary.

bugs.summary: The vantage-plate block (storyJobPipeline Phase 5a-pre-vantage) never called validateEmptyScene while the per-page path always has — on job_1788123310558 empty-scene QC ran 0 times (all pages were vantage-covered) and the p2 plate shipped with a blocked foreground and paper margins, exactly the defect classes the validator checks.
bugs.note: Reused, not redesigned: the same validateEmptyScene + one retry-with-feedback loop as the per-page path, called per plate. textPosition passed as null (a shared plate serves pages with different text zones, so no calm-zone grading; the pixel white/black-box artifact checks and the vision people/foreground/signage checks all still run). characterPlacements = union of sceneMetadata.fullData.characters across the plate's page group; storyEra derived identically to the per-page path. Retry validated pixel-only (skipVision) and kept only when it passes or has fewer issues. Outcomes genLogged (vantage_plate_qc / vantage_plate_qc_failed / vantage_plate_qc_retry) and the v1/v2 QC history stored on sceneBackgrounds in the same shape the per-page path stores. A validator error keeps the unvalidated plate — QC can never cost a plate.

bugs.summary: The proofread stream leaked reasoning prose ('Let me work through this carefully page by page.') and a finding that withdraws itself mid-line ('...as a compound image is fine — withdraw. Let me re-examine.') into the corrective round: the withdrawn line still matches FAULT_LINE_RE so it was counted and merged raw (job_1788123310558 stored proofread: countFaults=9 vs the model's own FAULTS: 8). NOTE — the second half of the reported premise did NOT reproduce: proofread findings were NOT dropped from the corrective round; the stored audit2 of the same job contains the proofread faults verbatim (gleichmässig, Leimnaht), wired since the b81c5010c-era merge at textRefine.js. The corrective round ran with them and changed zero pages — a model outcome, not missing wiring.
bugs.note: textRefine.js: sanitizeProofreadFindings() keeps only lines matching ^FAULT[TAG]*: and discards any FAULT line carrying a withdrawal marker (withdraw / '— fine' / re-examine); the sanitized form feeds countFaults and the audit2 merge, the raw stream stays persisted for traceability, and discarded lines are logged. Unit-checked against the stored output (scratchpad piraterun/q7-ai-dialogue/tr-proofread.txt): 9 -> 8 faults, the withdrawn Möwensegel line and the reasoning leak both dropped, matching the model's own FAULTS: 8 tally. The main audit stream is deliberately untouched (different format, out of scope).
